scale.note: Bands are for the full slate pool (every projected skill player, ~10 per team). MAE is dominated by outcome noise: a hindsight oracle that knows each player's true season average still scores MAE 4.04 on this pool, so ~4.0 is the floor and 3.0 is not attainable. Starters-only pools run 1.5-2 points higher (FFA 5.95 on players projected 8+). A single 30-player slate has an MAE standard deviation of ~0.8, so judge on 5+ weeks (~1,500 player-games) and on the same-rows comparison with FFA and DraftKings.
